title: When CamAPS reports reports ≤2.2 or ≥22.3 xdrip leaves an empty gap
body:
### Subject of the issue
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2008#discussioncomment-3458602

“The notifications CamAPS gives when exceeding the dexcom ranges report ≤2.2 or ≥22.3 which xdrip seems to be unable to interpret and the value is empty. Is there anyway these values could be interpreted as the values at the top or bottom of the range?”


### Your environment
Nightly build 6th July 2022 using Companion as data source to read from CamAPS.


### Expected behavior
When exceeding the dexcom range the values could be interpreted as the highest or lowest values rather than leaving a gap in the data.

### Actual behavior
Gaps in data, xdrip logs show “Did not find any matches”.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
Using CamAPS as data source wait for a
BG reading below 2.3 or above 22.3.

### Screenshots
See discussion thread.
